entries.1bf9a461e9a8b1d1: The company manufactures components such as automotive air conditioners and engine-related parts, and electronic components that control vehicle operation, and supplies them to automakers. Customers provide production plans on a quarterly basis, and the company produces in line with them in a forecast-based production format. Its main customers are the Toyota Group. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales to TOYOTA MOTOR CORPORATION accounted for 26.4% of revenue. It also produces products not installed in vehicles, such as factory automation equipment, QR code readers and water heaters.
